title: Tevesh Szat | Planeswalker
description: Learn more about the Planeswalker Tevesh Szat, from Magic: The Gathering.

paragraphs.text: Tevesh Szat was a member of Urza’s Nine Titans, a band of powerful Planeswalkers recruited to destroy Phyrexia. Urza predicted Tevesh Szat’s eventual betrayal, using the draconic Planeswalker’s life to engineer Phyrexia’s demise.
